# Skills de terceiros vendorizadas nos plugins.
# Formato: <plugin>[,<plugin>...] <repo-url> <nome-da-skill>
# Rode scripts/sync-vendor.sh depois de editar. Linhas com # ficam de fora.

# habii-core — agnóstico de stack
habii-core https://github.com/mattpocock/skills tdd
habii-core https://github.com/mattpocock/skills grill-with-docs
# grill-with-docs só chama estas duas; sem elas ele quebra:
habii-core https://github.com/mattpocock/skills grilling
habii-core https://github.com/mattpocock/skills domain-modeling
# GraphQL agnóstico de stack: desenho de schema e operações (web, mobile e Rails).
habii-core https://github.com/apollographql/skills graphql-schema
habii-core https://github.com/apollographql/skills graphql-operations

# Cliente GraphQL (React) — web e mobile
habii-ts,habii-mobile https://github.com/apollographql/skills apollo-client

# habii-ts — TypeScript full-stack (React + Fastify + Prisma)
habii-ts https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills vercel-react-best-practices
habii-ts https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills vercel-composition-patterns
habii-ts https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills web-design-guidelines
habii-ts https://github.com/anthropics/skills frontend-design
habii-ts https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser agent-browser
habii-ts https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui shadcn
habii-ts https://github.com/mcollina/skills fastify-best-practices
habii-ts https://github.com/prisma/skills prisma-client-api
habii-ts https://github.com/prisma/skills prisma-cli
# tRPC e TanStack Query não são vendorizados: as skills vêm dentro dos pacotes npm,
# na versão instalada, via TanStack Intent (o habii-setup roda `npx @tanstack/intent@latest install`).

# habii-mobile — React Native com Expo
# As skills oficiais da Expo não são vendorizadas: o habii-setup liga o plugin `expo` do
# marketplace oficial (expo/skills), mantido pela Expo.
habii-mobile https://github.com/callstackincubator/agent-skills react-native-best-practices
habii-mobile https://github.com/callstack/react-native-testing-library react-native-testing
habii-mobile https://github.com/callstackincubator/agent-skills react-navigation
habii-mobile https://github.com/callstackincubator/agent-device agent-device

# Fora por decisão (descomente para incluir):
# grill-me: sobrepõe grill-with-docs e disputa o acionamento.
# habii-core https://github.com/mattpocock/skills grill-me
# caveman: economiza saída, mas deixa as explicações telegráficas; melhor como opt-in pessoal.
# habii-core https://github.com/juliusbrussee/caveman caveman
# token-efficiency: ~4k tokens por uso, descrição genérica que dispara quase sempre
# e recomenda bash em vez de ler arquivos, contrariando o padrão do Claude Code.
# habii-core https://github.com/delphine-l/claude_global token-efficiency
# vercel-react-view-transitions: 14 KB e muito específica.
# habii-ts https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills vercel-react-view-transitions
# vercel-react-native-skills: sobrepõe react-native-best-practices (Callstack) e disputa o acionamento.
# habii-mobile https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills vercel-react-native-skills
# upgrading-react-native: para projetos bare; em Expo use expo-upgrade, do plugin expo.
# habii-mobile https://github.com/callstackincubator/agent-skills upgrading-react-native
# apollo-server: o servidor GraphQL do time é Rails (graphql-ruby), não Apollo Server.
# habii-ts https://github.com/apollographql/skills apollo-server
